title: UniFi — Sonos & Kitchen WiFi
description: Focused view on Sonos device signal quality, dropout correlation with guest activity, and kitchen-area AP health.

panels.title: Sonos RSSI (now)
panels.description: Signal strength at the Sonos device. Below -75 dBm is problematic.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_client" and r._field == "rssi" and r.is_sonos == "true")
  |> last()

panels.title: Sonos SNR (now)
panels.description: Signal-to-noise ratio. Below 20 dB causes dropouts.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_client" and r._field == "snr" and r.is_sonos == "true")
  |> last()

panels.title: Sonos Satisfaction Score
panels.description: UniFi's own per-client health score (0-100). Under 60 = poor experience.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_client" and r._field == "satisfaction" and r.is_sonos == "true")
  |> last()

panels.title: Total WiFi Clients (now)
panels.description: High client count = channel congestion = Sonos dropouts.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_summary" and r._field == "wifi_clients")
  |> last()

panels.title: Sonos RSSI vs Total WiFi Clients
panels.description: Correlation view: watch for RSSI dips when client count spikes (guests arriving).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_client" and r._field == "rssi" and r.is_sonos == "true")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "rssi")

from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_summary" and r._field == "wifi_clients")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Sonos Signal Quality Detail (RSSI / SNR / Satisfaction)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_client" and r.is_sonos == "true")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rssi" or r._field == "snr" or r._field == "satisfaction")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Kitchen AP Channel Utilisation
panels.description: High channel utilisation (>60%) on the AP the Sonos connects to is the most common cause of audio dropouts.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ap_radio" and r._field == "channel_utilization")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Sonos TX Rate (Mbps)
panels.description: Sustained low TX rate indicates poor RF conditions even when connected.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_client" and r._field == "tx_rate" and r.is_sonos == "true")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Clients per AP (congestion heatmap)
panels.description: Which AP is overloaded? Each line is one AP's connected client count.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ap_radio" and r._field == "num_sta")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Sonos-Related Network Events (disconnects / roams)
panels.description: Filtered to disconnect, reconnect, and roaming events — the signature of a dropout.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "unifi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_event" and r._field == "message")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.event_key =~ /disconnect|roam|handover|EVT_WU/)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
